**Command injection in `src/net/ping.py:9`** — the change replaces a safe argument-list `subprocess.run([...])` call with a shell string built via `"ping -c 1 " + host` and `shell=True`. Since `host` comes straight from the unauthenticated `request.GET` param, an attacker can inject shell metacharacters (`;`, `&&`, `` ` ``, `|`, `$()`) to run arbitrary commands on the server.

**Fix:** revert to the list form without `shell=True`, e.g. `subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", host], capture_output=True, text=True)`, and ideally validate `host` against an expected hostname/IP pattern before use.
